g.text: Left: a full bounded queue signals the producer to slow down. Right: two isolated pools -- one overloaded, one unaffected.
queue full -> producer must slow down or be rejected
Bounded queue: producer blocks or gets an explicit reject once full.
Unbounded queue: memory grows until the process is OOM-killed --
taking every already-queued request down with it, not just the new load.
Analytics exhausting its own pool never touches checkout's pool --
